mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the net result of inputs minus outputs."
Ecosystem nutrient balance is the net result of inputs minus outputs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the automated phenate method 4500-NH3 G. (APHA, 1998)."
Analysis method is the automated phenate method 4500-NH3 G. (APHA, 1998).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a measure of the clarity of a water body."
Turbidity is a measure of the clarity of a water body.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a measure of the limit of vertical visibility in the upper water column and a direct function of water clarity."
The Secchi disk depth is a measure of the limit of vertical visibility in the upper water column and a direct function of water clarity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to improve water quality for use in the home and industry."
Several methods are used to improve water quality for use in the home and industry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the junction where a river flows into the ocean."
An estuary is the junction where a river flows into the ocean.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the concentration of hydrogen ions, expressed as a negative logarithm."
The pH of water is the concentration of hydrogen ions, expressed as a negative logarithm.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used as cooling and process water for commercial washing, ornamental fountains, fire fighting, golf course irrigation, creation of artificial wetlands, and groundwater recharge."
Treated wastewater is used as cooling and process water for commercial washing, ornamental fountains, fire fighting, golf course irrigation, creation of artificial wetlands, and groundwater recharge.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) as the 12-nautical mile zone from the baseline or low-waterline along the coast."
The territorial sea is defined under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) as the 12-nautical mile zone from the baseline or low-waterline along the coast.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential micronutrient to freshwater flora and fauna."
Iron is an essential micronutrient to freshwater flora and fauna.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the formation of large amorphous metal hydroxides e.g. iron III and aluminum which adsorb and enmesh particles in suspension and allow their removal by sedimentation and filtration."

Flocculation refers to the formation of large amorphous metal hydroxides e.g. iron III and aluminum which adsorb and enmesh particles in suspension and allow their removal by sedimentation and filtration.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a finite and vulnerable resource, essential to sustain life, development and the environment."
Freshwater is a finite and vulnerable resource, essential to sustain life, development and the environment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is termed as "good" or "poor" depending on the designated use of the water."
Water quality is termed as "good" or "poor" depending on the designated use of the water.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential nutrient for plants, animals and plays a major role in biological metabolism."
Phosphorus is an essential nutrient for plants, animals and plays a major role in biological metabolism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the colour of water upon removal of suspended solids or when the sample has been filtered."
True colour refers to the colour of water upon removal of suspended solids or when the sample has been filtered.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fertilisation of surface waters by nutrients that were previously scarce (Carpenter et al. 1999)."
Eutrophication is the fertilisation of surface waters by nutrients that were previously scarce (Carpenter et al. 1999).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential plant nutrient and its levels in natural waterways are typically low (less than 1 mg/L)."
Nitrate is an essential plant nutrient and its levels in natural waterways are typically low (less than 1 mg/L).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the portion of total suspended solids (TSS) lost on ignition (heating to 550°C)."
Volatile suspended solids (VSS) is the portion of total suspended solids (TSS) lost on ignition (heating to 550°C).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a strong oxidant and rapidly kills many harmful microbes."
Chlorine is a strong oxidant and rapidly kills many harmful microbes.

disc

Natural wetlands are those that do not result from human activities.

Similar methods are used for both wastewater and drinking water purification.

Electrical conductivity is the measure of the ability of water to conduct an electric current.

______ is the least abundant and most limiting for biological productivity of a water body.

Surber sampler
